# crosswork_assign_devices_to_device_group (Resource)

This resource makes a list of devices that are members of a device group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_assign_devices_to_device_group" "example" {
  group_id = "2661ed2d-11fb-49c4-9f9f-f71f1c12767b"
  devices  = ["build-router-1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `devices` (Set of String) Inventory ids of the devices that are members of the group; an empty list removes them all
- `group_id` (String) Id of the device group

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_assign_devices_to_device_group.example "<group_id>"
```
